Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.perplexity

Class PerplexityHarvester

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.perplexity.PerplexityHarvester
@Component public class PerplexityHarvester extends Object
Infrastructure adapter that harvests AI-in-Healthcare articles via the Perplexity Sonar API (POST https://api.perplexity.ai/chat/completions).

When PERPLEXITY_API_KEY is set as an environment variable (resolved via aihealthcare.perplexity.api-key in application.yml), this adapter makes a live HTTP call to the Sonar sonar model with the active PERPLEXITY search prompt. The response citations[] array (URLs cited by the model) is mapped to NewsArticle records with sourceTier="PERPLEXITY" and sourceWeight=0.85.

When the API key is absent or blank the adapter returns an empty list and logs an info message — no exception is thrown. The calling pipeline (e.g. PerplexityResearchAdapter) handles empty results gracefully.

All API call failures are caught and logged; the method returns an empty list so the research pipeline can always fall back to Google DB articles.

The harvest prompt is resolved at call time via SearchPromptPort using the "PERPLEXITY" engine key. If no active prompt exists the adapter returns an empty list and logs a warning.

API endpoint: 

 POST https://api.perplexity.ai/chat/completions
 Authorization: Bearer {PERPLEXITY_API_KEY}
 Content-Type: application/json
 { "model": "sonar", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "{prompt}"}] }

  • Method Details

    • harvestArticles

      public List<NewsArticle> harvestArticles(String topic)
      Harvests AI-in-Healthcare articles for the given topic via the Perplexity Sonar API. Returns an empty list when the API key is absent, no active PERPLEXITY prompt is configured, or the API call fails.
      Parameters:
      topic - The healthcare topic to research (e.g. "AI diagnostics"). Uses "AI in Healthcare" when null or blank.
      Returns:
      Harvested articles with sourceTier="PERPLEXITY"; never null.
